text:
### Operational & Support Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **SOPs & Procedures** | Current + 2 prior versions | Governance, audit trail |
| **Policy Documents** | Permanent (all versions) | Governance, legal |
| **Training Records** | 3 years | Compliance training verification |
| **Staff Disciplinary** | 6 years from action | Employment law |
| **System Access Logs** | 1 year | Security, audit |
| **Backup Tapes** | 30 days (rotating) | Disaster recovery |
| **Email (general)** | 1–3 years | Business efficiency |
| **Email (legal/compliance)** | 7 years | Legal hold |

raw_entities.name: Document Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the retention periods and bases for operational, support, and compliance documents across the organisation. The policy establishes mandatory retention schedules for SOPs, policy documents, training records, disciplinary files, system logs, backups, and email communications, with retention periods ranging from 30 days to permanent, based on governance, legal, audit, and security requirements.
context: Operational & Support Documents | Document Type | Retention Period | Basis
Policy Documents | Permanent (all versions) | Governance, legal
Training Records | 3 years | Compliance training verification
System Access Logs | 1 year | Security, audit

raw_entities.name: Retention of Standard Operating Procedures and Procedures
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of current versions of SOPs and procedures plus the two prior versions to maintain governance and audit trail integrity.
context: SOPs & Procedures | Current + 2 prior versions | Governance, audit trail

raw_entities.name: Permanent Retention of Policy Documents
raw_entities.description: Mandates permanent retention of all versions of policy documents to satisfy governance and legal requirements.
context: Policy Documents | Permanent (all versions) | Governance, legal

raw_entities.name: Training Records Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of training records for 3 years to enable verification of compliance training completion and audit compliance.
context: Training Records | 3 years | Compliance training verification

raw_entities.name: Staff Disciplinary Records Retention
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of staff disciplinary records for 6 years from the date of action to comply with employment law requirements.
context: Staff Disciplinary | 6 years from action | Employment law

raw_entities.name: System Access Logs Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of system access logs for 1 year to support security monitoring and audit requirements.
context: System Access Logs | 1 year | Security, audit

raw_entities.name: Backup Tapes Retention
raw_entities.description: Establishes a 30-day rotating retention schedule for backup tapes to support disaster recovery operations.
context: Backup Tapes | 30 days (rotating) | Disaster recovery

raw_entities.name: General Email Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of general business email for 1–3 years to balance business efficiency with record-keeping obligations.
context: Email (general) | 1–3 years | Business efficiency

raw_entities.name: Legal and Compliance Email Retention
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of email containing legal or compliance content for 7 years to satisfy legal hold and regulatory requirements.
context: Email (legal/compliance) | 7 years | Legal hold

raw_entities.name: Governance and Audit Trail Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that inadequate retention of SOPs, procedures, and policy documents could compromise the organisation's ability to demonstrate governance compliance and maintain an auditable record of operational decisions.
context: SOPs & Procedures | Current + 2 prior versions | Governance, audit trail
Policy Documents | Permanent (all versions) | Governance, legal

raw_entities.name: Employment Law Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of non-compliance with employment law arising from inadequate retention or loss of staff disciplinary records.
context: Staff Disciplinary | 6 years from action | Employment law

raw_entities.name: Security and Audit Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that loss or inadequate retention of system access logs could compromise security monitoring capabilities and audit trail integrity.
context: System Access Logs | 1 year | Security, audit

raw_entities.name: Disaster Recovery Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that inadequate backup tape retention could impair the organisation's ability to recover from system failures or data loss events.
context: Backup Tapes | 30 days (rotating) | Disaster recovery

raw_entities.name: Legal Hold and Regulatory Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of non-compliance with legal hold obligations and regulatory requirements arising from inadequate retention of legal and compliance-related email communications.
context: Email (legal/compliance) | 7 years | Legal hold

properties.scope_summary: Defines retention periods for operational, support, and administrative documents including SOPs, policies, training records, disciplinary files, system logs, backups, and email
properties.core_policy_statement: Documents must be retained according to specified periods based on governance, compliance, legal, and operational requirements

properties.name: Retention of Standard Operating Procedures and Procedures

properties.evidence_required: Maintained versions of all SOPs and procedures
Complete archive of all policy versions
Documentation of all training completion and attendance
Rotating backup tape inventory and schedule
Segregated legal and compliance email archive

properties.risk_definition: Loss or inadequate retention of governance documentation and audit trails that support organizational accountability and decision-making
properties.required_response: Maintain current SOPs plus 2 prior versions; retain all policy versions permanently

properties.risk_definition: Failure to retain employment-related records required by employment law, exposing the organization to legal liability
properties.required_response: Retain staff disciplinary records for 6 years from action date; retain training records for 3 years

properties.risk_definition: Inadequate retention of system access logs compromising security monitoring and audit capabilities
examples: Loss of audit trail for system activities
properties.required_response: Retain system access logs for 1 year

properties.risk_definition: Inadequate backup retention strategy compromising business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities
properties.required_response: Maintain rotating backup tapes with 30-day retention cycle

properties.risk_definition: Failure to retain legally significant communications and compliance records, exposing the organization to regulatory and litigation risk
examples: Premature deletion of legal and compliance emails
Loss of evidence for regulatory investigations
properties.required_response: Retain legal and compliance emails for 7 years; general email for 1–3 years
